svg.desc: About Us Bureau Égyptien de Conseils Techniques (BECT) is an Expertise House in Engineering Consultancy (the highest ranking of consulting ﬁrms in Egypt), and certiﬁed ISO 9001:2015. BECT was established in Cairo since 1989, with a Saudi branch located in Riyadh since 2007. BECT has elaborated hundreds of projects in the ﬁelds of Planning, Urban Design, High-Tech Buildings, Transportation, Infrastructure, Industrial Installations, Health Complexes, etc. The studies of many projects were not limited to the architectural & civil aspects but also to all technical categories of the engineering ﬁelds including urban, landscape, geotechnical, electrical power networks & systems, mechanical systems, plumbing, HVAC, ﬁre-ﬁghting systems, in Board of Directors Over the years, BECT has cultivated signiﬁcant expertise in collaborating with both national and international organizations, whether independently or as part of esteemed professional consortiums. The company’s extensive experience encompasses a broad range of industries and sectors, allowing it to effectively navigate complex challenges and deliver impactful solutions. Furthermore, BECT has had the honor of contributing to numerous high-proﬁle projects funded by international ﬁnancial institutions (IFIs), including the World Bank (WB), the European Investment Bank (EIB), the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), and the Asian Development Bank (ADB). These projects have ranged from infrastructure development and capacity building to policy advisory and technical assistance, highlighting BECT’s ability to adapt to diverse requirements and deliver results that meet global standards. By fostering strong partnerships and consistently demonstrating its capabilities, BECT has established itself as a trusted and reliable partner for organizations aiming to implement transformative initiatives on a local, regional, and global scale. Our CEOs Dr. Omar El Husseiny Prof. Omar El Husseiny, Co-Founder of BECT, brings nearly 40 years of distinguished experience in architecture and urban design. After earning his MSc and PhD in France, he returned to Egypt and built a notable career leading large-scale projects from master planning to execution. His expertise spans architectural design, urban development, and comprehensive project management. Dr. Ossama El Husseiny Prof. Ossama has successfully balanced his professional career between design and project management within the private sector and academic work at the Faculty of Engineering. He expanded his expertise during his PhD studies in France and further enriched it upon returning to Egypt, leading major projects both locally and internationally across various sectors.
